description: This file defines the OrderDAO interface, which specifies data access methods related to 'Order' entities in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and querying orders, as well as managing related entities like OrderType, OrderFrequency, OrderGroup, and their attributes.

classes.name: OrderDAO
classes.description: Interface declaring data access operations for 'Order' entities and related objects within the OpenMRS data layer.

methods.name: saveOrder
methods.description: Saves an Order object to the database and returns the saved instance.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes a specific Order from the database.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its ID.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Orders based on various filtering parameters, including order type, patients, concepts, orderers, and encounters.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves Orders for a specific patient and care setting, filtered by order types and inclusion flags for voided and discontinuation orders.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves Orders based on search criteria encapsulated in an OrderSearchCriteria object.

methods.name: getOrderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Order based on its UUID.

methods.name: deleteObsThatReference
methods.description: Deletes observation records that reference a specific Order.

methods.name: getOrderByOrderNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Order based on the order number.

methods.name: getNextOrderNumberSeedSequenceValue
methods.description: Returns the next sequence value used for generating order numbers.

methods.name: getActiveOrders
methods.description: Retrieves active Orders for a specific patient, order types, care setting, and date.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a CareSetting object by its ID.

methods.name: getCareSettingByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CareSetting by its UUID.

methods.name: getCareSettingByName
methods.description: Retrieves a CareSetting by its name.

methods.name: getCareSettings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all CareSettings, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType by its name.

methods.name: getOrderFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderFrequency by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderFrequency by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderFrequency objects, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderFrequencies matching a search phrase, locale, and inclusion flags.

methods.name: saveOrderFrequency
methods.description: Saves an OrderFrequency to the database.

methods.name: purgeOrderFrequency
methods.description: Deletes an OrderFrequency from the database.

methods.name: isOrderFrequencyInUse
methods.description: Checks whether an OrderFrequency is referenced by any existing Orders.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderFrequency associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all OrderTypes, including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByConceptClass
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType associated with a specific ConceptClass.

methods.name: saveOrderType
methods.description: Saves an OrderType.

methods.name: purgeOrderType
methods.description: Removes an OrderType from the database.

methods.name: getOrderSubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves subtypes of a specific OrderType.

methods.name: isOrderTypeInUse
methods.description: Checks whether an OrderType is used by any existing Order.

methods.name: getDiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the discontinuation Order for a given Order.

methods.name: getRevisionOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a revision Order based on an existing Order.

methods.name: getOrderFromDatabase
methods.description: Fetches an Order from the database with options for drug orders and specific criteria.

methods.name: saveOrderGroup
methods.description: Saves an OrderGroup entity.

methods.name: getOrderGroupByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroup by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroup by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient
methods.description: Gets all OrderGroups associated with a specific patient.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter
methods.description: Gets all OrderGroups associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available OrderGroupAttributeTypes.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Saves an OrderGroupAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderGroupAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all OrderAttributeTypes.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getActiveOrders
methods.description: Retrieves active Orders for a patient, visit, order types, care setting, and date.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves Orders for a patient, visit, care setting, order types, including or excluding voided and discontinuation orders.
